detail.name: Starlight - Billy's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Starlight - Billy's Mindscape: Knight's Chivalry
detail.desc2:
A card printed with an image of Knight Billy and his upgraded armaments.
A special, customised Starlight Knight official fan's namecard. Though real heroes need no anti-counterfeit proof, there is indeed a gilded one on the card... This hero, however, is a familiar yet unfamiliar one.
